types.name: Mirror image
types.description: You select the mirror image of a figure, word or number combination when a mirror is placed beside it (at MN, PQ or AB, or "to the right").

types.name: Water image
types.description: You select the water image (reflection in water below the object) of a figure, word or number combination.

types.name: Paper folding, punching and cutting
types.description: A sheet is folded one or more times and then punched or cut, and you choose how it looks when unfolded.

types.name: Folding a transparent sheet
types.description: A transparent sheet with a pattern is folded along a dotted line, and you choose how the folded sheet looks.

types.name: Counting triangles
types.description: You count the number of triangles in a figure made of crossing lines.

types.name: Counting squares, rectangles and other shapes
types.description: You count squares, rectangles, lines or other shapes (anything except triangles) in a figure.
